name: AgenticOS Brain
description: Dispatches a turn to the AgenticOS brain plane over the HTTP+SSE bridge and returns the brain's final output.

baseUrl.label: Bridge Base URL
baseUrl.help: HTTP base URL of the AgenticOS bridge (brain plane).

authToken.label: Bridge Bearer Token
authToken.help: Sent as `authorization: Bearer ...`. Falls back to the AGENTICOS_BRIDGE_TOKEN environment variable.

timeoutMs.label: Turn Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Wall-clock ceiling for one whole turn. Defaults to 120000.

defaultTarget.label: Default Target
defaultTarget.help: Brain-plane executor used when a tool call omits target_kind/target_id.
